revisions.reason: Promote brainstormed legacy project v1.5.2 cutover path into frozen truth: legacy detection, one-command phased migration, governance verify, stale skill detection, fail-closed mixed authority, and resume original refreeze intent after successful cutover.
accept tasks.md as requirement-owned task intent consumed by implement plan without progress writeback
accept friction routing simplification and doctor truth-source mismatch closure

items.text: Cutover preflight detects legacy or mixed truth state, including old `prd/`, `user-story/`, `qa/test-cases/` surfaces, missing feature package files, missing governance MD, missing projection, and stale agent-surface guidance.
`beacon-change-refreeze` must detect legacy/mixed state before refreeze and route to cutover instead of presenting `beacon change ... --refreeze-chain` as sufficient.

Beacon exposes a human-facing one-command cutover wrapper that runs or reports phases: inventory, package materialize/validate, truth-map verify, governance verify/projection, agent-surface refresh, and resume.
Requirement package cutover must validate `features/<slug>/{truth,tests,tasks,evidence}.md` as v1.5.2 package authority; legacy triptych can be absorb/rebuild/archive-only and cannot win authority.
Project governance cutover must verify `docs/beacon/governance/project-version-governance.md` and generated sqlite/runtime projection, failing closed on missing version contract or projection drift.
Cutover must detect stale installed/project skills or agent rules that still present old triptych as normal v1.5.2 truth authority and route to `doctor setup-agent-surface` / verify.
Freeze, refreeze, implement, QA, and release must fail closed while package authority, governance MD, or agent-surface verification is incomplete or contradictory.
After successful cutover, Beacon resumes the original operator intent, such as refreeze, without requiring the operator to rediscover the next command.
Implement current frozen revision
